decisions.label: Limit per member
decisions.summary: A member may hold at most three books at a time.

decisions.label: Block after a late return
decisions.summary: A late return blocks new loans until the book is back.

requirements.label: Loans blocked while a book is late
requirements.summary: No new loan is allowed to a member who holds a late book.

script: Architecture session for the loans service.
We enforce the limit of three books per member inside the loans service, checked when a loan is created.

drafts.title: Enforce the limit in the loans service
drafts.summary: The loans service checks the limit when a loan is created.

script: Architecture session for the loans service, second proposal.
To keep the queue short we let members with a late book borrow once more, then block them.

drafts.title: Allow one more loan after a late return
drafts.summary: A member with a late book may take one more loan before the block applies.
